card.definition: An adjective is a word that tells about a noun. It tells what kind, how many, or which one.

example.text: The fluffy kitten slept in the basket.
example.note: Fluffy is the adjective. Kitten is the noun it tells about.

card.how: Fluffy tells what kind of kitten it is.
